result.summary: Found 2 issues on the home screen. The main defect is a loading spinner stuck over an image that has already loaded. The other is a low-contrast favorite button on the same card.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner sits in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, even though the ramen image is fully rendered behind it. The loading state was never cleared, so the card looks like it is still loading and part of the image is covered.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image load event fires, and add a timeout/error fallback so the spinner cannot remain after the image has loaded or failed.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a dark translucent circle that blends into the dark image. The button's outline is barely visible, unlike the clearly visible circle on the next card.
issues.suggestion: Use a higher-contrast or more opaque background for the heart button (e.g., a darker scrim or a light circle with a dark icon) so it stays visible on any image.
